verdict: A pending reboot is blocking the operation. An earlier install or update is waiting on a restart before new installs can proceed.
fix: Reboot the client. If a reboot has been pending for an extended period, investigate what originally required it (Windows Update, a previous app install) via: `Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 200 | Where-Object { $_.Id -in 1074,1076,6005,6006,6008 }` and the Component-Based Servicing event log. Clear the pending marker keys if they are stale and a reboot has already happened: `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Component Based Servicing\RebootPending` and `HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\PendingFileRenameOperations`.
